description: An inverted bodyweight pressing movement focusing vertical pushing strength on the shoulders and triceps.
setup: Form an inverted V-shape with hands shoulder-width on the floor, hips pushed high toward the ceiling, and legs straight.
steps: Shift your weight slightly forward onto your hands while looking toward your feet.
Lower the crown of your head diagonally forward to touch the floor in front of your fingertips.
Press firmly through your palms diagonally backward to return to the pike peak.
cues: Form a tripod between your head and two hands at the bottom
Push the floor away actively at the top to shrug your shoulders into your ears

mistakes.mistake: Dropping head straight down between hands instead of forward
mistakes.fix: Aim the crown of your head ahead of your fingertips forming an equilateral triangle

mistakes.mistake: Flaring elbows wide out to the sides
mistakes.fix: Keep elbows angled 45 degrees back toward your body

rep_standard: Begins in high pike with arms straight, head taps ground forward of hands, and finishes with head pushed through shoulders back to peak.
